questions.questionText: hour Additional Materials: Multiple Choice Answer Sheet Soft clean eraser Soft pencil (type B or HB is recommended) READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS FIRST Write in soft pencil. Do not use staples, paper clips, glue or correction fluid. Write your name, Centre number and candidate number on the Answer Sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you. DO NOT WRITE IN ANY BARCODES. There are forty questions on this paper. Answer all questions. For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the separate Answer Sheet. Read the instructions on the Answer Sheet very carefully. Each correct answer will score one mark. A mark will not be deducted for a wrong answer. Any rough working should be done in this booklet. Electronic calculators may be used.

questions.questionText: A cell secreting glycoproteins is supplied with radioactively-labelled glucose which is detected in the cytoplasm first. In which organelle would radioactively-labelled glucose be detected next? A B C D
The diagram shows some similarities between chloroplasts, mitochondria and typical prokaryotes.

A student carried out four tests for biological molecules on a solution. The results are shown in the table. test for biological observation molecule iodine solution orange biuret blue Benedict’s orange emulsion clear Which molecules are present in this solution?
Which bonds will be broken when a molecule of amylose is hydrolysed?
Which statement describes how the molecular structure of starch is suited to its function?

options.A: Amylose has a branched structure and amylopectin is coiled to give a compact molecule for transport.
options.B: In the breakdown of amylose and amylopectin, many condensation reactions release stored energy.
options.C: In the formation of amylose and amylopectin, many hydrolysis reactions allow the release of stored energy.
options.D: The amylose-amylopectin complex is insoluble and does not affect the water potential of the cell.

questions.questionText: Which comparative statements concerning biological molecules are correct?
In triglyceride molecules, where are double bonds located?

options.B: within fatty acids and within glycerol

The graph shows the rate of activity of the enzyme sucrase plotted against the concentration of sucrose. rate of enzyme activity 6 / arbitrary units 0 20 40 60 80 100 concentration of sucrose / g dm–3 Why does the rate of enzyme activity remain constant from 80–90gdm–3.

options.A: All the enzyme has been inhibited.
options.B: All the substrate has been used up.
options.C: The concentration of the enzyme is limiting the rate.
options.D: The concentration of the substrate is limiting the rate.

questions.questionText: The diagram shows part of a cell surface membrane.
One type of antigen is formed by a reaction between two different molecules. Apart from oxygen, which other elements are found in this antigen?
What are the features of facilitated diffusion?

Single-celled animals that live in fresh water have a vacuole that contracts regularly to remove excess water. Single-celled plants that live in fresh water do not have a similar vacuole. Which statement explains why these animals need this vacuole but plants do not?

options.A: Plant cell cytoplasm and animal cell cytoplasm both have a lower water potential than fresh water.
options.B: Plant cell sap has the same water potential as fresh water, animal cytoplasm has a lower water potential than fresh water.
options.C: Plant cell walls are impermeable to water, animal cell surface membranes are permeable to water.
options.D: Plant cell walls restrict the entry of water, animal cell membranes allow the entry of water.

options.B: the production of cancerous tissue in alveoli

questions.questionText: A total of 3 × 106kJm–2yr–1 is available from the producers in an ecosystem. In theory, how much of this energy would be available to tertiary consumers?
In a food chain, which link involves the least efficient energy transfer?

options.A: Bull fishes feed on small crustacea.
options.C: Mangrove plants trap sunlight during photosynthesis.
options.D: Small crustacea feed on dead mangrove leaves.
